metadata.title: A Poincare-Einstein Liouville Theorem and the Yamabe Invariant of Lens Spaces
metadata.abstract: Schoen conjectured that the Yamabe invariant of every lens space is achieved by the round metric. A proof of this conjecture is presented for all lens spaces, together with rigidity: equality is only achieved for the round class. The key step is to show that every $\mathbb Z_p$-invariant Yamabe-positive conformal class on $S^3$ admits a $\mathbb Z_p$-equivariant Poincaré-Einstein filling. The distance function from a fixed point of the filling then gives an invariant test function with Yamabe quotient at most $\sigma(S^3)$, which descends to the lens space. The proof of the main theorem was generated by AI (ChatGPT Astra, September 2026); this is mainly a learning note of the AI generated proof.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 作者提出的猜想证明笔记
analysis.workSummary: 作者提出通过等变 Poincaré–Einstein 填充与不变测试函数证明所有透镜空间的 Yamabe 不变量由圆度量实现，并给出等号刚性。
techniques: 填充中固定点的距离函数
analysis.breakthrough: 作者以欧氏共形无穷远的四维Poincaré–Einstein Liouville命题控制填充退化，并通过模二度论主张所有Zₚ不变Yamabe正共形类有等变填充。填充内固定点产生不变测试函数，下降得σ(L(p,q))=p^(−2/3)σ(S³)，圆共形类为等号情形。
analysis.limitations: 作者明确将主要证明称为ChatGPT Astra生成证明的学习笔记；Li–Qing–Shi结果的简化适配另归作者。所读范围限主定理、导言路线及填充与透镜空间结论，未独立核验Liouville分析、边界映射紧性或等变度论。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确将透镜空间猜想的主要证明及新想法归于2026年9月与 ChatGPT Astra 的工作，并以学习笔记解释，正文文字由作者撰写。第3页和第38页另将 Li–Qing–Shi 结果的简化论证归于作者自己。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.08957v1 · PDF 第1页摘要及 AI Disclosure，第3页组织说明
